# WheelMonitor transcripts. Each 'tick' is one 1-second monitor wait; the fake advances one phase per tick.
# Frozen from the legacy C# implementation by tools/G29.Reference (reference.ps1).
# Do not edit by hand. These vectors are the oracle for the Brainfuck port.
# scenario <name> <range> <autocenter> <idle>; 'log <message>' is what the monitor reported; 'return' ends Run.
# Enumerations are not logged. idle is 'infinite' or the idle timeout in seconds (only 0 is exercised: timing).
